description: Create WallConfigPanel component for Designer canvas and wire it into App.tsx. Panel shows wall configuration, panel layout, spacing, and mounting sections. Always visible in DESIGNER mode.
steps: 1. Create frontend/src/components/WallConfigPanel.tsx with wall configuration, panel layout, spacing, and mounting sections using wallConfigStore
2. Update frontend/src/App.tsx to import and render WallConfigPanel in DESIGNER mode (replace conditional ZonePropertiesPanel)
acceptance_criteria: WallConfigPanel renders in DESIGNER mode and is always visible (not conditional on selection)
Panel has Wall Configuration section with Wall Type (read-only), Total Width, Total Height
Panel has Panel Layout section with Rows dropdown, Columns input, Panel Fit dropdown, Fit Intensity slider
Panel has Spacing section with Panel Gap, Edge Margin Left, Edge Margin Right
Panel has Mounting section with Mounting Type dropdown
Panel shows generated panel frame count at the bottom
App.tsx shows WallConfigPanel in Designer mode instead of conditional ZonePropertiesPanel
verification: unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd frontend && npx vitest run
findings: All 1094 tests pass. TypeScript typecheck clean (only pre-existing ValidationOverlayLayer unused var). Added edge_margin_left_mm and edge_margin_right_mm as optional fields to WallConfigInput type. The wallConfigEngine now subtracts edge margins from available width and offsets panel x positions by the left margin. The WallConfigPanel uses wallConfigStore.setWallConfig() for all changes. Panel is always visible in DESIGNER mode alongside the conditional ZonePropertiesPanel (which still shows when a zone is selected).
